mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_HELM + i from HelmMale{i+1}, so file 02 is index 1, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Dragon Helm.
why_this_one: Devias's merchants (Izabel, Zienna in src/sim/market.cpp) list the Dragon set; the body was built for Apostle Devin's reward and the shelf dropped the other four pieces for want of a cooked mesh.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateArmor(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)`, so slot 2 is group 7, 3 is 8 and 4 is 9.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 1, 0 - the Dark Knight alone.

sheet_from: Data/Player/head_03.OZJ (64x64) and skin_barbarian_01.OZJ, from MuMain's Player tree at c0d74c4 - the plain HelmMale02.bmd. The .bmd names head_03.jpg (143 triangles) and skin_barbarian_01.jpg (51): the helm carries its own face, so no keeps_head (helm index 1 is not in SetCharacterScale's condition).
sheet_note: head_03 is the dragon's skull: red lacquered plate with bone-gold horns and jaw, mean (118, 63, 53).
material_overrides_why: The Dragon Armor's first override (f0 0.42 at 0.70 of the art, desaturation 1.0, roughness 0.55) rather than the body's later 0.50/0.60/0.42: at the body's values the two long bone horns, near-white on head_03, mirrored the stage's fire as glowing spikes at dusk and night, with a bloom halo. The calmer figure keeps the red and gold and puts the horns back to bone-gold; judged on the studio sheet 2026-09-30.

upscale.why: 3x at detail 0.35 as on the Dragon Armor: a dark small sheet at 0.65 grows generated grain.
